title: PLAZA / TARE DRUNK barks
description: A drunk girl who has fallen down the stairs near the waterfront. You can steal her tare bag. She mumbles something about bottles..

dialogueTree.speaker: Tare Drunk -> N/A
dialogueTree.polish: „Lepiej gadaj, na co przy mnie uważasz, młody... czk”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Лепш языком сваім сачы пры мне, хлопча... (ік)."

dialogueTree.speaker: Tare Drunk -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Nuthin' I *can't* do. I'm the job for every man..."
dialogueTree.polish: „Mogię *wszystko*. Żadna praca się mnie nie boi...”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Няма нічога, чаго б я *не мог*. Ніякая праца мяне не баіцца..."

dialogueTree.speaker: Tare Drunk -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Lsss-sen, boy, I don't start trouble, I fix it."
dialogueTree.polish: „Sssuchaj, młody. Ja nie robię problemów, ja je naprawiam”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Ссс-слухай, хлопча, я не ствараю праблем, я іх вырашаю."

dialogueTree.speaker: Tare Drunk -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "I've been kicked out of every joint in Revachol!"
dialogueTree.polish: „Wyrzucali mnie z każdej knajpy w Revacholu!”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Мяне выкідалі з кожнай забягалаўкі ў Рэвашолі!"

dialogueTree.speaker: Tare Drunk -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "That's my song! That's a... nah, 'tis's s-sshit..."
dialogueTree.polish: „To mój kawałek! To jest... nieee... To jakieś gówno...”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Гэта ж мая песня! Гэта... не-е, гэта г-ггаўно..."

dialogueTree.speaker: Tare Drunk -> N/A
dialogueTree.polish: „M-m-muzyka to moje życie jest, stary... czk...”
